answer:
The Spanish verbs note now has a game on its App side. It's a timed quiz built from your verb table.

- **A round:** 10 questions. Each shows a verb and four choices, with a timer bar running. Faster answers score more, and three or more right in a row starts a combo multiplier (x2, then x3). You can also tap or press 1–4 to answer.
- **Between rounds:** you get a review of the verbs you missed, confetti for a new best score or a perfect round, and a play-again button.
- **Progress:** the home screen shows your day streak, best score and a mastery bar. Each verb is marked 0–3. A right answer raises it and a miss resets it to 0. Verbs you know less well come up more often.
- **Settings:** under App Settings you can change the direction (Spanish to English, English to Spanish, or mixed), the seconds per question and the questions per round.
- **Your table:** it reads the Spanish | English table, so any verbs you add show up in the game.

The final check reports one item: "no control sent an edit." The game keeps its scores in the app's own data and never edits your note, so that's expected. I couldn't play it myself, so I haven't seen it running.
